principle.name: THE CATCH SPENDS VERTICAL DEBT WHILE FORWARD DEBT SURVIVES
principle.summary: A convincing forward catch is prepared before launch, distinguishes probe contact from trusted support, lets the root continue past first touch, compresses deeply after ownership is earned, overshoots through the torso/arms, and exits with unresolved next-step recovery rather than returning to idle.
principle.minimal_maximal_unit: one repaired forward support-ownership handoff from rear coil through launch/probe/catch to an asymmetric recovery-debt exit

keys.name: COILED_REAR_LOAD
keys.causal_role: compresses over trusted rear support while shoulders counter-wind
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root=(10,13); near-zero x travel; pelvis sinks and chest/head lag rearward before commitment

keys.name: HEEL_RISE_COMMIT
keys.causal_role: deepens coil, narrows rear support, and sends lead knee forward before root launch
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root=(11,14); x barely advances while y compresses to the deepest coil

keys.name: PUSH_OFF_STRETCH
keys.causal_role: rear support spends stored compression; pelvis begins a rising forward arc and limbs open asymmetrically
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root=(14,12); acceleration begins; lead limb reaches while rear toe remains the sole trustworthy contact

keys.name: TOE_RELEASE_LAUNCH
keys.causal_role: last rear-toe support releases only after the root has clearly committed forward
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root=(18,9); largest upward velocity; chest overtakes pelvis and the lead foot travels on a high forward arc

keys.name: FLIGHT_SPLIT
keys.causal_role: suspends on a long split silhouette with no fake planted support
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root=(24,7); ballistic crest begins; limbs counter-swing around a forward-moving pelvis

keys.name: DESCENDING_PROBE
keys.causal_role: lead foot reaches ground ahead of the root while torso deliberately lags, making touch distinct from ownership
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root=(31,8); fastest horizontal spacing; pelvis leads chest; right foot touches at x=41 without yet arresting the root

keys.name: CATCH_FOLD
keys.causal_role: probe earns root ownership and converts vertical/downrange velocity into a deep asymmetric fold without freezing x
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root=(34,13); catch compression is deepest; support foot stays planted at x=41 while pelvis continues past its probe position

keys.name: TORSO_OVERSHOOT
keys.causal_role: pelvis rebounds while torso/head overshoot the support line and the free-side arm whips late
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root=(38,12); x still advances; torso crosses ahead of pelvis as catch energy resolves instead of reversing

keys.name: HIP_DRIVE_PASS
keys.causal_role: hips pass the planted foot and lift; recovery leg swings forward on its own arc while support remains unchanged
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root=(41,9); pelvis rises and moves beyond support; free knee leads the next action but does not touch down

keys.name: SECONDARY_LAG_SWING
keys.causal_role: root decelerates while arms reverse later than hips; the recovery leg continues past the body without planting
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root=(43,10); horizontal spacing compresses; shoulder line counters the hip drive rather than snapping to neutral

keys.name: RECOVERY_KNEE_LEADS
keys.causal_role: free knee remains ahead while torso falls slightly behind pelvis, preserving visible next-step debt
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root=(45,11); forward travel is now small but nonzero; free foot remains airborne and no second support transfer is invented

keys.name: DEBT_CARRY_EXIT
keys.causal_role: finishes the handoff on the new support with torso/arm/free-leg debt still visible; it is not a returned idle
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root=(47,11); settles one unit forward while the free leg stays in recovery; next action must resolve the remaining asymmetry
